criteria.statement: assistant.llm_streaming exists on AssistantConfig, defaults to false, and can be enabled from YAML.
BAHIA_ASSISTANT_LLM_STREAMING enables the same assistant.llm_streaming setting through the assistant flat-compat environment path.
When StreamingEnabled is false, the legacy assistant planner uses PlanFromPrompt even if the client supports PlanFromPromptStreaming.
When StreamingEnabled is true and the client supports streaming, the legacy assistant planner uses PlanFromPromptStreaming.
Application wiring passes cfg.Assistant.LLMStreaming into AssistantOrchestratorConfig.StreamingEnabled without changing the bahia-m6qs chat client fallback.
